home.name: Great Neck Baseball League Fields
home.directions: Turn onto Shorehaven Drive from N. Great Neck Road, pass Cox High School, turn left into the Great Neck Baseball League parking lot (the Recreation Center will be on your right).
home.parking: No parking at the Recreation Center at any time. Grass medians are tow-away. Weekend decal parking outside Bronco field is for umpires, coaches of record and board members only.
